analysis.title: Dark Futurist Learning Dashboard
analysis.notes: A dark educational landing page combines a monumental headline with a polished futuristic 3D object and colorful floating course cards. Rock-like monochrome texture, rounded framing, neon accents, and layered depth create a tactile sci-fi presentation.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a cinematic 3D hero visual for a futuristic learning platform: a compact spherical training device with a translucent shell, precision mechanical ribs, glowing cyan core, lime indicator lights, and subtle holographic interface markings. Place it floating against a deep charcoal background with soft amber atmospheric light, crisp metallic reflections, and restrained sci-fi detailing. Compose the object large on the right side with generous negative space on the left for headline typography; use a premium product-render aesthetic, dramatic rim lighting, and no logos, brands, or readable text.
